summary: Your saved settings keep up with improved defaults, and every reported problem now has its own support code.

new.title: Settings follow improved defaults
new.text: Alerting and mail settings now keep only what you changed. When PIM Manager improves a default later, you get it automatically, and every choice you made stays as you set it.

fixes.title: A support code for every problem
fixes.text: Each problem PIM Manager reports now carries its own support code, so support finds the cause and the fix at once.

fixes.title: Clearer names in the security pack
fixes.text: The security pack names each part by what it does, with one table that lists every name.

fixes.title: Mail password set safely
fixes.text: Setting the mail relay password no longer gives the person running it extra rights in Key Vault. The step names the right it needs.
